conventions.rig: each target's own skeleton (snow/rain: 55-bone Root/Hips/... h55 rig; hazmat: CTS mannequin names); armature + 1-tri _bind_proxy; rest (T/A pose) keyed one frame before the take so FBX node defaults = rest
conventions.facing: character faces -Y in Blender = +Z in Unity (FBX -Z forward / Y up export)
conventions.loops: in place (mean travel velocity removed; planted feet move backward at native_speed_mps); last frame == first frame (Unity Loop Time, no Loop Pose needed); locomotion loops start at the LEFT foot plant so walk/jog/sprint are phase-aligned for a 1D blend tree
conventions.oneshots: translation kept in the hips (start at origin facing forward); turns keep yaw in the hips
conventions.metres_per_cycle: body travel over one loop at 1x = native_speed_mps x duration_s; playback rate for a speed v = v / native_speed_mps
